messages:
Priya: Hi all — kicking off the Vesper Health activation. I'm the CS lead. Objective: full search integration + production pilot within 30 days so we can surface renewal signal. Posting the playbook, owners, and a couple of contingency items. Short and actionable please.

Ken: I'll own endpoint routing, canary policy, and alerting hooks. Need their expected peak QPS and dataset size to size Dedicated trial.

Marco: I'll take ingestion pipeline + mapping. Ask: do they need us to retain raw payloads beyond 30 days? If yes, add retention config to policy.

Jordan (Vesper): From our side: PM (Jordan), Infra (Rae). We can share sample export by EOD. Retention: likely 90 days, but will confirm.

Priya: Thanks Jordan. Key risks: SSO delays, schema mismatches, and relevance regressions on search. Contingency notes below.

Liaison-bot: Shared doc: https://docs.redwood.internal/onboarding/vesper-playbook (view only)

Priya: Owners (compact):
1) Access + billing/account setup — Priya
2) SSO (SAML cert & metadata) — Ken — due Day 5
3) Ingest & schema mapping — Marco — Day 1-6
4) Enablement workshop (customer ops + infra) — Priya/Marco — Day 3
5) Canary traffic + perf baseline — Ken/Marco — Day 10-16
6) Quality gating & NPS pulse — Priya — Day 14
7) Renewal trigger review — Priya — Day 25-30

Priya: Success metric formula (add to tracker):
```
Activation = (avg_daily_queries >= 120) AND (90th_latency_ms < 700) AND (Day14_CSAT >= 4.0)
Renewal_signal = Activation AND (usage_growth_7d >= 10%)
```

Marco: Note on schema gaps: we can add a shim to map missing fields, but that adds ~2-4 dev days and will push Day 6 -> Day 10 depending on complexity. Flagging as Medium risk.

Ken: SSO plan: I'll request SAML metadata and cert today. If vendor requires cert chain reformatting, eng-security will need to assist (2-3 business days). If SSO slips beyond Day 7 we'll use token-based fallback for initial tests.

Jordan (Vesper): We'll try to prioritize SSO. If SSO delayed, we can run private-key token auth in staging for the first 10 days.

Priya: Escalation path:
- Day 3 blocker -> @Priya + 24h ping to Solutions Eng
- Day 7 blocker impacting activation -> escalate to Director CS + Eng oncall
- SSO >10d or schema unresolved >14d -> classify as High renewal risk and prepare executive outreach

devops-bot: Runbook entry created: "vesper-activation-3167894321". Tags: onboarding, high-touch, trial.

Priya: Enablement agenda draft: 1) Objectives & KPIs 2) Integration demo (ingest -> query) 3) Ops (alerts, quotas, rollback) 4) Live Q&A. Target audience: PM + infra + search owner from Vesper.

Marco: Rollback/fallback options: enable prefix caching + degrade to cached-results endpoint if relevance drops during canary. Toggling is via ops flag `use_cached_fallback=true`.

Ken: Quotas proposal for trial: start with 15 RPS, 2M tokens/day, enable burst 30 RPS for 1 hour windows during pilot. We'll tune post-baseline.

Priya: NPS & feedback cadence: quick pulse at Day 14 (3 Qs), then qualitative check-in Day 21. I'll own the survey and capture verbatim feedback in the tracker.

Jordan (Vesper): PM will attend Day 3 workshop. Infra lead might be available Day 4-5; will confirm tomorrow.

Priya: Calendar invites incoming. Please accept and add 30-min weekly check (Weds 11:00 PT). If anyone wants a different time ping me.

calendar-bot: Event created: "Vesper Activation - Weekly 30m" Wednesdays 11:00-11:30 PT — Priya, Ken, Marco, Jordan (Vesper).

Priya: Final asks: update the shared tracker with any dependencies you surface (eng-security, SSO vendor, sample exports). I'll summarize risks and send an executive one-pager if we hit High risk by Day 10. Thanks team.
